title: Two students in Class 12
body: Kavya and Tanvi study in the same class. Kavya completes every assignment on time, listens to instructions carefully, learns quickly and reproduces what she has learnt accurately; she has the highest marks in the class and scored much higher than Tanvi on an intelligence test. However, she rarely offers ideas of her own. Tanvi's marks are average, but she prefers to learn on her own, thinks up new ways of doing her projects and recently devised a simple way of reusing kitchen water for the plants at home. Their class teacher, Mr Sharma, says: 'Since Kavya has the higher IQ, she must also be the more creative of the two.'
